Name: PilotsDock
Description:
Directly control your FlightSim from your StreamDock! Map Actions to Sim Events and show Sim Variables on the Buttons.

NOTE FOR UPGRADES: Please use the Installer from the GitHub Page (under Releases)!

Localization.If you still have the old Profiles in yo:
If you still have the old Profiles in your StreamDock Software, the new Profiles will be added as a Copy by the Software.
The Installer will delete the old Profile (kept in Trash), rename the new Profile and will copy the existing Mapping over.
The Matching is done by the Profile's Name and the Installer will only change/remove anything when there is a 1:1 Match.
